title: Notify operator when cross-PC MAP authority is unavailable
description: Add a boot-persistent, non-AI watchdog around mirror synchronization that records failures, retries, sends rate-limited desktop alerts when RUKI cannot be reached or a snapshot fails validation, and sends a recovery notification.
acceptance_criteria: Mirror sync failures are persisted and produce a desktop notification once a graphical session is available.
Repeated failures are rate-limited and do not notify every minute.
The first successful sync after a failure records recovery and sends a recovery notification.
No UI, Codex session, or local LLM is started by the watchdog.
Installer keeps standalone and authority defaults unchanged and installs the watchdog wrapper.
